output.reason: The linked PR [ev-3b4a914a270f] states what the subject is and what changed: it adds a new `StrictChecks` option to the `consulcatalog` provider. The option sets which Consul healthcheck statuses let an upstream be included as a target. The same PR says the default is "passing", "warning", which keeps the existing behavior, so the change is backwards compatible. That means nothing happens to a consulcatalog user who does nothing. [ev-4f6cea17395d] explains why the option exists: operators can now leave out "warning" upstreams. The changed files [ev-705bbeea26db] show it is a static-configuration option, documented in the CLI, env, file.toml and file.yaml references. The two proposals cited only the one-line changelog entry [ev-351b6ab48cff] and never looked at this PR.
